questions.question:
다음 <보기>에서 [동사원형-동명사]의 형태가 올바른 것은 모두 몇 개인가?

<보기> visit - visitting 
write - writing
tie - tieng
find - finding
leave - leaving
read - reading
catch - catching
run - runing
live - liveng
study - studing
questions.explanation: visit-visiting, tie-tieng(X), leave-leaving, catch-catching, live-liveng(X), write-writing, find-finding, read-reading, run-runing(X), study-studying에서 올바른 것은 visit-visiting, leave-leaving, catch-catching, write-writing, find-finding, read-reading, study-studying으로 7개입니다. 다시 확인하면 보기에 제시된 10개 중 올바른 것은 3개입니다.

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
________ pictures is fun for them.
questions.explanation: 문장의 주어가 필요하며, 동명사(Taking)를 사용해야 합니다. Taking pictures(사진을 찍는 것)이 주어 역할을 합니다.

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞지 않은 것은?
Did you ________ cleaning your rooms?
questions.explanation: "Did you hope cleaning your rooms?"는 문법적으로 부자연스럽습니다. hope는 일반적으로 to부정사를 따르므로 동명사와 함께 사용되지 않습니다.

questions.question:
다음 문장의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 어색한 것을 모두 고르면?
I ________ playing soccer.
questions.explanation: "I hoped playing soccer"는 부자연스럽습니다. hope는 to부정사(I hoped to play soccer)를 취하기 때문입니다.

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 공통으로 들어갈 알맞은 말은?
• Thanks for ________ me.
• ________ other people is natural.
questions.explanation: 첫 번째 문장에서 "Thanks for helping me"(나를 도와줘서 감사합니다)와 두 번째 문장에서 "Helping other people is natural"(다른 사람을 돕는 것은 자연스럽습니다)에서 동명사 "helping"이 공통으로 들어갑니다.

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
John enjoys ________ pictures with his friends.
questions.explanation: "enjoy"는 동명사를 목적어로 취하므로 "taking"이 올바릅니다. "John enjoys taking pictures"입니다.

questions.question:
다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 순서대로 알맞은 것은?

A: You must ________ playing computer games right now.
B: Mom, give me five more minutes, please.
A: You must ________ reading this book. This is your English homework.
B: Oh, I forgot about it.
questions.explanation: 첫 번째 문장은 "You must stop playing computer games right now"(지금 당장 컴퓨터 게임을 중단해야 한다)이고, 두 번째 문장은 "You must stop reading this book"이 아니라 "You must finish reading this book"(이 책을 읽기를 마쳐야 한다)이므로 "stop - finish"입니다.

options: I gave up to study Math.
She kept to smile and look at her baby.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 올바른 문장은?
questions.explanation: "He finished cleaning the room"이 올바른 문장입니다. finish는 동명사를 취합니다. 다른 문장들은 다음과 같이 수정되어야 합니다: ①give up to study → give up studying, ②mind to read → mind reading, ④learn playing → learn to play, ⑤kept to smile → kept smiling

options: Take a walk in the city is very difficult.
I enjoy to read comic books.
We go to fish and swimming in summer.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 올바른 문장은?
questions.explanation: "Collecting stamps is my hobby"가 올바릅니다. 동명사가 주어로 사용되었습니다. ①Take a walk → Taking a walk, ③enjoy to read → enjoy reading, ④swimming → swim (병렬구조), ⑤read → reading

options: He likes to bake a cake.
She enjoys to read history books.
I practice driving a car every day.
Learning how to cook is very fun.
Do you mind turning off the TV?
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장은?
questions.explanation: "She enjoys to read history books"는 올바르지 않습니다. enjoy는 동명사를 취하므로 "She enjoys reading history books"로 수정되어야 합니다.

options: He wanted riding a bike after lunch.
Would you mind sending this letter?
When did she begin teaching students?
We'll avoid answering the phone after 5.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장은?
questions.explanation: "He wanted riding a bike after lunch"는 부자연스럽습니다. want는 to부정사를 취하므로 "He wanted to ride a bike after lunch"로 수정되어야 합니다.

options: My hobby is collect the pretty dolls.
I miss working in the travel industry.
Sera kept to practice more and more.
Semi finished to do the project quickly.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 올바른 문장은?
questions.explanation: "I miss working in the travel industry"가 올바릅니다. miss는 동명사를 취합니다. ①wanted dancing → wanted to dance, ②collect → collecting, ④kept to practice → kept practicing, ⑤finished to do → finished doing

options: Jina wants to play with a ball.
Brian and Suji enjoy learning baseball.
I practice to speak English every day.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장은?
questions.explanation: ①②③④는 모두 문법적으로 올바릅니다. ⑤"I practice to speak English"는 "I practice speaking English"로 수정되어야 합니다.

options: She's good at playing the violin.
Use an electronic dictionary is useful.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장은?
questions.explanation: ①②③④는 모두 올바른 문장입니다. ⑤"Use an electronic dictionary is useful"는 "Using an electronic dictionary is useful"로 수정되어야 합니다.

options: Swimming is a piece of cake.
Getting up early is a good habit.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장은?
questions.explanation: ①②③⑤는 올바릅니다. ④"Sharing common interests are important"는 주어(Sharing)가 단수이므로 "Sharing common interests is important"로 수정되어야 합니다.

options: Nobody imagined having a cell phone those days.
Do you mind my opening the window?
Don't give up to solve the problem.
Please finish doing the laundry soon.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장은?
questions.explanation: ①②⑤는 올바릅니다. ③"opening"은 가능하지만 일반적으로 ④"give up to solve"는 "give up solving"으로 수정되어야 합니다.

options: Watching movies is a lot of fun.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장은?
questions.explanation: ①②③④는 모두 올바릅니다. ⑤"I want watching movies"는 "I want to watch movies"로 수정되어야 합니다.

questions.question:
다음 밑줄 친 곳 중 어법상 어색한 것은?
①Could you please stop *making* so much noise?
②I like *taking* photographs when I'm on holiday.
③She tried *to read* her book but she was too tired.
④She enjoyed *listening* to music when she was a teenager.
⑤Do you remember *to switch* the lights off before we came out?
questions.explanation: ⑤"remember to switch"는 "remember switching"으로 수정되어야 합니다. remember + 동명사는 과거의 일을 기억하는 뜻이고, remember + to부정사는 해야 할 일을 기억하는 뜻입니다. 여기서는 전후 문맥상 "remember switching"이 맞습니다.

options: My hobby is listening to music.
Playing the guitar is very interesting.
She stopped writing a letter and went out.
You didn't finish to clean the room.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장은?
questions.explanation: ①②③④는 모두 올바릅니다. ⑤"finish to clean"은 "finish cleaning"으로 수정되어야 합니다.

options: I can't live without reading books.
I'll call you when I finish working.
Having breakfast is good for your health.
Learning English take a lot of time and effort.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 것은?
questions.explanation: ⑤"Learning English take"는 "Learning English takes"로 수정되어야 합니다. 주어 "Learning English"가 단수이므로 동사도 단수형 "takes"를 사용해야 합니다.

options: Jay avoids to tell the truth.
Anne practices singing for the contest.
I enjoy playing tennis with my friends.
Lisa gave up reading her history book.
Yuri likes to write letters for her friends.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장을 고르면?
questions.explanation: ①"avoids to tell"은 "avoids telling"으로 수정되어야 합니다. avoid는 동명사를 취합니다.

options: I finished to wash the dishes.
Do you enjoy to watch movies?
Is taking pictures still your hobby?
Dohun does not like listen to music.
Eating vegetables are good for your health.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 올바른 문장은?
questions.explanation: ③"Is taking pictures still your hobby?"가 올바릅니다. ①finished to wash → finished washing, ②enjoy to watch → enjoy watching, ④like listen → like listening, ⑤Eating vegetables are → Eating vegetables is

options: Do you mind open the window?
Watch movies is my mom's hobby.
Her job is teach science in high school.
I finished cleaning my house two hours ago.
Getting a cook license in Korean cuisine are a requirement for the job.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 올바른 문장은?
questions.explanation: ④"I finished cleaning my house two hours ago."가 올바릅니다. ①mind open → mind opening, ②Watch → Watching, ③teach → teaching, ⑤are → is

options: He stopped smoking for your health.
When you leave, don't forget to lock the door.
I couldn't buy anything because I forgot to bring money.
I remembered to visit the Taj Mahal several years ago.
Please remember to turn off the radio before you go out.
questions.question: 어느 것이 문법적으로 올바르지 않은가?
questions.explanation: ④"remembered to visit"는 "remembered visiting"으로 수정되어야 합니다. remember + 동명사는 과거에 한 일을 기억하는 뜻이므로 "remembered visiting"이 올바릅니다.

questions.question:
다음 중 밑줄 곳 중 부분이 어법상 올바른 문장을 모두 고르면?
㉠ *Keeping* a diary is fun.
㉡ *To live* without air is impossible.
㉢ Do you *mind to open* the door?
㉣ My dream is *becoming* a singer.
㉤ Jane will learn *to speak* Spanish.
questions.explanation: ㉠은 동명사 사용 올바름, ㉡은 to부정사 사용 올바름, ㉢은 "mind to open"이 아니라 "mind opening"으로 수정되어야 함, ㉣은 동명사 사용 올바름, ㉤은 to부정사 사용 올바름. 따라서 ㉠,㉡, ㉣, ㉤이 올바릅니다.
